name: duel-1
title: The duel, phase 1 (Move): two virtual players' first duel, in the temple and then the forge, seen as a player sees it (the duel's locked camera, the HUD on screen once src/hud is joined). Each shot is the duel from its first frame: the count-in, then play, the brains seeded, deterministic.

shots.note: the temple's court, the fallback arena (the altar and the pillars solid, the lintel one-way): fire, showy (wall-jump chains, flips, cartwheels), against water, aggressive; from the count-in, the camera the duel's own lock
the sky forge's anvil over the pit (no floor: a fall is a KO), the floats and the crown bobbing: water, evasive, against fire, aggressive
